Key Id.description: Identifies which published Chat Service key signed this message; empty when unsigned

Message Id.description: Client generated id for this message; empty when unsigned

Redacted Text.description: Redacted form of the message; empty means nothing needed redacting

Room Id.description: Room the signature was minted for, empty when unsigned; a receiver rebuilds over its own and will not match otherwise

Scan Text.description: The message the Chat Service scanned and signed

Sender Id.description: The identity the Chat Service signed against; empty when unsigned

Signature.description: Chat Service signature over the fields above; empty when the sender could not sign
